title: [text] truncate: characterization test for truncate with limits of one or less
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceAI-Workspace

add a characterization test for truncate in src/text.ts: short limits
- truncate("abc", 1) is "a"
- truncate("abc", 0) is ""
- truncate("abcd", 2) is "a…"

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). src/text.test.ts never reaches the maxLength <= 1 branch; this pins it (the negative-limit case is a separate bug task, not pinned here). Self-zone task on PeaceAI-Workspace: one new src/*.test.ts file only. No gate, grading, approval, leak, rule or workflow file is touched. A box dry-run on PeaceAI-Workspace c7ba0a5 (Workspace main, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with truncate stubbed); with all five new tests of this batch: typecheck ok, npm test 17/17, test:self 5/5, test:tools 1077/1078 (only the box-only m48 snapshot test). Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
